"""Source-bound figures; maps are descriptive change fractions, never labels."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import cv2
import numpy as np

from matplotlib import colormaps

ROOT=Path.cwd();OUT=ROOT/'sample/output/s11-temporal-texture-20261010-004'
FIG=OUT/'figures';FIG.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
D=json.loads((OUT/'readout.json').read_text())
fontpath='/System/Library/Fonts/Supplemental/Arial.ttf'
def font(n):return ImageFont.truetype(fontpath,n)
BG=(17,24,32);FG=(231,236,243);MUTED=(172,187,203);MISSING=(100,100,100)
CMAP=colormaps['viridis']
def heat(a,num,den,r):
    counts=a[den]; fraction=np.divide(a[num][r],counts,out=np.zeros_like(counts,dtype=float),where=counts>0)
    pixels=(CMAP(fraction)[:,:,:3]*255).astype(np.uint8)
    pixels[counts==0]=MISSING
    return Image.fromarray(pixels)
manifest=[]
native=[]
for c in D['cases']:
    with np.load(c['array_path'],allow_pickle=False) as raw:a={k:raw[k] for k in raw.files}
    h,w=a['canny'].shape; scale=1 if w>200 else 3
    pw,ph=w*scale,h*scale;pad=24;header=116;footer=54
    canvas=Image.new('RGB',(5*pw+6*pad,ph+header+footer),BG);draw=ImageDraw.Draw(canvas)
    label=f"{c['case_id']} | original source X{c['crop_xyxy'][0]}:{c['crop_xyxy'][2]}, Y{c['crop_xyxy'][1]}:{c['crop_xyxy'][3]} | {len(c['decoded'])}/15 frames"
    draw.text((pad,14),label,font=font(23),fill=FG)
    availability='Full time window' if c['full_window'] else 'TRUNCATED time: side comparisons unavailable'
    draw.text((pad,45),availability+' | Colours = code change frequency, not Foam or truth',font=font(19),fill=MUTED)
    ims=[Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(a['crops'][c['anchor_i']],cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB))]
    ims+=[heat(a,f'{ch}_changes',f'{ch}_pairs',r) for ch in ('direct','registered_to_anchor') for r in range(2)]
    titles=['Source + all center edges','Direct R1','Direct R2','Registered R1','Registered R2']
    cx=c['source_column_x']-c['crop_xyxy'][0]; y0=c['crop_xyxy'][1]
    for i,(im,title) in enumerate(zip(ims,titles,strict=True)):
        left=pad+i*(pw+pad)
        draw.text((left,85),title,font=font(18),fill=FG)
        canvas.paste(im.resize((pw,ph),Image.Resampling.NEAREST),(left,header))
        x=left+cx*scale
        draw.line((x,header,x,header+ph-1),fill=(180,180,180),width=1)
        for source_y in c['central_edge_rows']:
            yy=header+(source_y-y0)*scale
            draw.line((x-3,yy,x+3,yy),fill=(255,138,72),width=1)
    draw.text((pad,header+ph+17),'Fixed 0..1 scale: purple = 0, yellow = 1; grey = no valid temporal pair. Orange ticks = all anchor Canny rows.',font=font(17),fill=MUTED)
    name=c['case_id']+'.png';canvas.save(FIG/name)
    manifest.append(dict(case_id=c['case_id'],path=str((FIG/name).relative_to(ROOT)),sha256=hashlib.sha256((FIG/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),source_array_sha256=c['array_sha256']))
    native.append(canvas)

for name,indices in [('water-all-1',range(5)),('water-all-2',range(5,10)),('sample4-all',range(10,17))]:
    width=1600
    thumbs=[native[i].resize((width,round(native[i].height*width/native[i].width)),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS) for i in indices]
    sheet=Image.new('RGB',(width,sum(im.height for im in thumbs)),BG)
    top=0
    for im in thumbs:sheet.paste(im,(0,top));top+=im.height
    sheet.save(FIG/(name+'.png'))

# Same A/B/C source convention; A stays closed and is omitted from this question.

draw.text((26,18),'Later water views | physical role not yet reviewed',font=font(28),fill=FG)
draw.text((26,59),'B / C keep their earlier source IDs. No detector, mask or truth overlay.',font=font(21),fill=MUTED)
patches=[]
for i,c in enumerate(selected):
    with np.load(c['array_path'],allow_pickle=False) as a: crop=a['crops'][c['anchor_i']].copy()
    x=26+i*556
    t=c['frame_index']/c['metadata']['fps']; label=('B','C')[i]
    draw.text((x,101),f"{label} | f{c['frame_index']} | {t:.3f} s",font=font(24),fill=FG)
    original=Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(crop,cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB))
    review.paste(original,(x+40,141))
    # Exact same pre-existing source detail X840:1070,Y450:540; no new crop search.
    detail=original.crop((100,200,330,290))
    draw.text((x,987),'Same centre detail, 2x nearest-neighbour',font=font(18),fill=MUTED)
    review.paste(detail.resize((460,180),Image.Resampling.NEAREST),(x,1020))
    patches.append(dict(label=label,case_id=c['case_id'],source_crop_xyxy=c['crop_xyxy'],

draw.text((26,1220),'Clean source pixels. A/f1232 Foam presence and unclear lower boundary remain closed.',font=font(18),fill=MUTED)
review.save(FIG/'later-water-role-review.png')
record=dict(schema='s11-temporal-texture-figures-v1',native_figures=manifest,review_patches=patches,
